## Findings refused

- Unit 1 i "had been in tears" (past perfect): ažuγ̇u 有來 is a plain past; kept, acceptable after kürbe.
- Unit 31 i drops the genitive of eke-jin ("Mother Sotan's gift"): sense and force are unchanged, note already explains.
- Unit 23 Ming 迭 ("in turn") against "escorting": mismatch is already confessed in n and morph; no better reading available from the Ming alone.
- Unit 39 baγ̇ulžu "take a wife in": already flagged as a guess; kept.
- Unit 46/51/63 bracketed (i) in köġün(i)-jen, emeġel(i)-jen, morid(i)-jan: could be accusative (Ming 行) or linking vowel; the draft treats it as Shiratori's, as does the published §87 part for deġü-ner(i)-jen; no change beyond keeping the note.
- Unit 35 "Tula": modern name for Tuγ̇ula; plain spelling, kept.
- Unit 67 Boγ̇orču glossed 女名行 by Ming: draft's slip theory is hedged; kept as is.
- Unit 5 "to me" supplied: flagged in n; kept.
- Unit 48 "you" (Temüjin addressed) removed; unit 49 "gave you" kept: n already says 'to you' is supplied.
- Unit 2 tense (present mu rendered as past): normal narrative; kept.
